decision: Reuse evaluate(), format_result(), CalculatorError, and SafeEvaluator; existing file already includes a Tkinter UI. Keep AST-based safe evaluation and improve validation before UI changes.
findings: Supports numeric constants, +, -, *, /, parentheses, and unary +/-; rejects names, calls, attributes, and other AST nodes.
Literal division by zero is converted to CalculatorError('Cannot divide by zero'), but computed zero denominators can leak ZeroDivisionError.
evaluate() maps syntax/value/overflow errors to 'Incomplete or invalid expression'; non-string input and some runtime errors are not normalized.
UI accepts transient incomplete expressions, displays errors as results, and clears/replaces the expression after any calculation attempt.
format_result() uses 12 significant digits and returns '0' for zero.
Decimal-entry logic is basic and may behave awkwardly around unary operators or incomplete operator sequences; no explicit length/range validation exists.
